positions.name: ReviewEnrollmentAssertion
positions.frame: what does the e2e suite verify about creator-to-reviewer enrollment when a memory is saved, and what does this artifact exist to prove?
positions.why: src-1 states the enrollment rule as a settled 'Decision' the e2e suite enforces; src-2 explicitly back-references 'that assertion' and frames the probe memory's entire existence as instrumental to carrying it. The two cohere as one directional read — a technical/matter-of-fact, present-tense, authority-ranking account of what the suite's behavior actually is and why this artifact exists — even though conviction differs (src-1 lands as decision/ratified, src-2 as a supporting claim); that gradient is held in tension rather than resolved, since both describe the same real test behavior.
